popCulture.title: Laocoön and His Sons
popCulture.description: The Vatican marble group — priest and sons crushed by sea-serpents — became antiquity's most famous image of agony and the Renaissance's school of suffering.

popCulture.title: Laocoön
popCulture.description: Laocoön endures as the warner who was right — "I fear the Greeks even when they bring gifts" — silenced by serpents so the horse could enter.
